## 1. File Structure

The file has no build step. All HTML, CSS, and JS are inline. JS is split into 15 `<script>` blocks in strict dependency order — later blocks depend on earlier ones.

| Block | Lines | Primary responsibility |
|-------|-------|----------------------|
| 1 | 2614–3452 | Security (TT), Crypto, Base64, Session key, AES, Vault IDB, Migration, Salt, DB layer, FS persistence, State/pub-sub |
| 2 | 3461–3543 | UI components, Command palette |
| 3 | 3544–3663 | Generic view renderers (List, Grid, Kanban, Spatial) |
| 4 | 3665–4117 | Project canvas |
| 5 | 4119–4224 | Record modal |
| 6 | 4225–4286 | Workspace shell (generic) |
| 7 | 4287–4375 | Dashboard |
| 8 | 4376–4653 | Calendar, Time tracker, Reports, Trash, Settings |
| 9 | 4655–5108 | Documents, editor, DOCX export |
| 10 | 5110–5386 | Library, Doc modal, File viewer |
| 11 | 5395–6594 | AI system v1 |
| 12 | 6595–7392 | AI v2 (overrides, wizard, cloud providers, secrets) |
| 13 | 7393–7526 | Files view, Sidebar, Bottom tabs, Topbar |
| 14 | 7527–7681 | Auth |
| 15 | 7682–7851 | App bootstrap (`init`, `fullRender`, `appRenderWorkspace`) |

The `<style>` block runs from line 29 to line 2608. There is one additional `<style>` context string at line 4864 (inside a template literal for a print window — it is not a real DOM style block and is not hashed by the CSP script).

## 2. Security Layer

### 2.1 HTTP Security Headers (lines 13–23)

| Header | Value | Purpose |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `Content-Security-Policy` | SHA-256 hashes for all 15 inline script blocks (style blocks not hashed — hashes in style-src cause browsers to ignore unsafe-inline per spec, blocking 177+ inline style= attributes); `strict-dynamic`; `trusted-types nexus-crm nexus-crm-raw`; `require-trusted-types-for 'script'`. Note: `frame-ancestors` is absent — browsers ignore it in meta tags (HTTP header only). | XSS mitigation |
| `Referrer-Policy` | `no-referrer` | No referrer data leaves the app |
| `Permissions-Policy` | camera, mic, geo, payment, usb, bluetooth all `()` | Locks out browser features not used |

CSP hashes are managed by `generate-csp.mjs`. Run it after every edit. It also writes `taskapp.sha256` for file integrity detection.

### 2.2 Trusted Types (lines 2616–2658)

| Symbol | Line | Type | Purpose |
|--------|------|------|---------|
| `_ttPolicy` | 2628 | `TrustedTypePolicy \| null` | `nexus-crm` policy — sanitises user data for innerHTML |
| `_rawPolicy` | 2640 | `TrustedTypePolicy \| null` | `nexus-crm-raw` policy — passes already-safe template HTML through unchanged. Created once here; shared by `patchInnerHTML` and any future caller. Never create this policy name again. |
| `patchInnerHTML()` | 2646 | IIFE | Overrides `Element.prototype.innerHTML` so all string assignments go through `_rawPolicy`. Falls back if Trusted Types not available. |

### 2.3 XSS Sanitisation

| Function | Line | Use |
|----------|------|-----|
| `escH(s)` | 3227 | Escapes `&`, `<`, `>`, `"`, `'`, newlines. Must be applied to all user-visible strings before innerHTML interpolation. |

### 8.2 State Shape

```
_state = {
  // Auth
  authed: boolean,
  cryptoKey: CryptoKey | null,

  // Navigation
  currentView: string,        // one of the 14 view keys
  sidebarCollapsed: boolean,
  theme: 'light' | 'dark',

  // CRM data (copies from _dbData)
  clients: [],

  // Timer

  // UI overlays

  commandOpen: boolean,
  notifPanelOpen: boolean,
  toast: { id, message, type } | null,
  confirmDialog: { message, onConfirm, onCancel } | null,

}
```

## 13. App Bootstrap

### 13.1 Functions

| Function | Line | Purpose |
|----------|------|---------|
| `appRenderWorkspace(view)` | 7685 | Partial re-render: replaces only `#workspace-container`. Cheaper than `fullRender`. |
| `fullRender(state)` | 7695 | Full re-render: sets `appEl.innerHTML` and rebinds all listeners. Called on state changes. |
| `init()` | 7715 | Startup sequence (see below) |

### 13.2 Startup sequence (`init()`)

1. `initTheme()` — apply theme immediately
2. `checkFileIntegrity()` (non-blocking async) — fetches `.sha256`, hashes self, shows warning banner if mismatch
3. `navigator.storage.persist()` — requests persistent IDB storage once per session
4. `_migrateLocalStorageToIDB()` — one-time vault migration
5. `fsInit()` — restore File System Access handle, maybe recover vault from disk
6. `loadSessionKey()` — if cached key exists and `verifyPassword` passes → `afterUnlock(key)` → done
7. Otherwise: `renderAuth()` / `bindAuth()` → on success → `cacheSessionKey(key)` → `afterUnlock(key)`

### 13.3 `afterUnlock(key)` sequence

1. `dbInit(key)` — load all CRM data
2. `setState({ authed: true, cryptoKey: key })` — mark authenticated
3. `reloadData()` — push data into state
4. `checkDueDates()` — initial due-date notifications
5. `aiSecretsRefresh()` — prime secrets cache
6. `fullRender(getState())` — render the full UI
7. `subscribe(...)` — register state change listener (`_unsubscribe` stored)
8. Keyboard handler — Ctrl+K, Escape
9. `setInterval(checkDueDates, 60000)` — due-date polling (ref stored as `_dueDateInterval`)
10. AI auto-reconnect — if prior tier selected

## 15. localStorage Keys Still in Use

These are intentional — all are non-sensitive preferences:

| Key | Where | Purpose |
|-----|-------|---------|
| `taskapp_theme` / `nexus_theme` | `setTheme()`, `_state` init | Light/dark theme |
| `taskapp_dash_v1` | `getDashLayouts()`, `saveDashLayouts()` | Dashboard widget positions |
| `taskapp_ai_prefs_v2` | `loadAIPrefs()`, `saveAIPrefs()` | AI tier, model selections, usage stats |
| `taskapp_ai_prefs_v1` | `loadAIPrefs()` — read only | Legacy migration source |

Vault data (`nexus_vault_v1`, `nexus_salt_v1`, `nexus_verify_v1`, `nexus_kdf_v`) was moved to IndexedDB `nexus_vault_v2`. The migration function `_migrateLocalStorageToIDB()` handles any existing data.

## 16. Developer Workflows

### Adding a new CRM store

1. Add the store name to `STORES` array (line 2957)
2. Add field schema to `SCHEMAS` object (line 4121) so the record modal works
3. Add column definition to `colMap` in `renderListView` (line 3550)
4. Add sidebar nav item in `renderSidebar` (line 7480) and `renderBottomTabs` (line 7489)
5. Add case to the `switch` in `fullRender`, `appRenderWorkspace` (lines 7691, 7698, 7701)
6. Add to `globalSearch` `SEARCH_FIELDS` (line 3175) if searchable
7. Run `node generate-csp.mjs`

### Adding a new large-content store (like documents)

Do **not** add to `STORES`. Instead:
1. Add to `IDB_STORES` array (line 2959)
2. Create its object store in `_dataDbOpen()` (line 2965)
3. All reads go through `_idbLoadStore`, all writes through `_idbPutRecord`

### Editing any JavaScript

After every edit: `node generate-csp.mjs`
This regenerates all 15 SHA-256 script hashes and the `taskapp.sha256` integrity file. The CSP meta tag is updated in-place.

### Running the app

Open `taskapp.html` in Chrome or Edge. No server needed (`file://` works). Keep `taskapp.sha256` in the same folder.

For Ollama: `OLLAMA_ORIGINS=* ollama serve`
For Chrome Built-in AI: requires Chrome 127+ with Prompt API available.

### Security rules summary

- `escH()` on every user string before `innerHTML`
- Never use `btoa(String.fromCharCode(...array))` — use `u8ToBase64()`
- Never create policy `nexus-crm-raw` a second time
- Never make `_dbKey` extractable
- Keep the four IDB databases separate
- Run `generate-csp.mjs` after every edit
